tier0_passive.description: Passive recon — DNS, TLS, headers, public JS analysis. No active probing.

tier1_safe_active.description: Safe active checks — CORS validation, JWT alg probe, DMARC spoof test, Nuclei cves/exposure/misconfig tags, Semgrep.

tier2_intrusive.description: Intrusive scanning — Nuclei intrusive/fuzzing tags, injection probing, brute-force. Requires per-run confirmation.

tier3_destructive.description: Destructive — DoS, lateral movement, credential replay. Never authorized for automated agents.

stop_conditions: target returns 5xx errors indicating scan is unwanted
